hardware_target.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (32 GiB GDDR7, sm_120)

r39_flagship_75gb_sub023.description: Flagship Round 3.9 build: QTIP HYB-mul1 (Rule A, 2.011 bpw) + 15.89% non-uniform LOO waterfill + Stage-2B Global-KL co-adaptation. Targets 74.66 GB served at <= 0.228 nats qbench KL and ~20-23 tok/s.

r39_sub70_69gb.description: Sub-70 GB Round 3.9 build: QTIP HYB-mul1 (Rule GU125, n1=256 k=1 tail rows on gate/up only, 1.917 bpw) + 18.65% non-uniform LOO waterfill + Stage-2B Global-KL. Targets 69.97 GB (or 68.90 GB with W20) at <= 0.253 nats KL.

r39_max_fidelity_83gb.description: Ultra-low-KL Round 3.9 build: QTIP HYB-mul1 (Rule A) + 4.86% non-uniform P5 prune + Stage-2B Global-KL. Targets 83.10 GB served at ~0.217 nats qbench KL.

r38_control_tcq33_75gb.description: Fast Round 3.8 control experiment: zero-reencoding slab compaction of existing TCQ33 via r34_prune_write.py + Stage-2B Global-KL router/table/scale co-adaptation. Targets 75.00 GB served at <= 0.260 nats KL.

r39s_agentic_serve_65k.description: Long-context multi-turn OpenAI HTTP serving profile for agent loops (`stable_messages` prefix caching + 14.0 GiB VRAM pool + 50 GiB DDR5 registered tier).
